metadata.name: Citrate cycle (TCA cycle) (KEGG map00020)
metadata.description: The citrate cycle with the entries and exits KEGG map00020 draws: pyruvate dehydrogenase, pyruvate carboxylase and PEP carboxykinase (anaplerosis), ATP-citrate lyase (citrate cleavage, reductive TCA / lipogenesis) and cis-aconitate as the aconitase intermediate. Derived from KEGG; drawn by GEMs MAP.

scope.note: The cycle is conserved; ATP-citrate lyase, PC and the ferredoxin-dependent oxidoreductases (PFOR, OGOR) are organism-specific. Compartments are left to the person mapping onto a GEM (mitochondrial in eukaryotes, cytosolic in prokaryotes).
